creator.description:
A labeler by @hailey.at, powered by https://github.com/roostorg/osprey

Labels are not absolute judgements, but rather information about the type of account or content you may be interacting with.

Ruleset: https://github.com/haileyok/atproto-ruleset

locales.description: This user is Hailey.
locales.name: Hailey

locales.description: This account is an AI agent.
locales.name: AI Agent

locales.description: Account engaging in mention facet abuse.
locales.name: Mention Facet Abuse

locales.description: Account followed 300+ in thirty minutes.
locales.name: Bulk Follows (300+)

locales.description: Account followed 1000+ in thirty minutes.
locales.name: Bulk Follows (1000+)

locales.description: Account that is almost certainly spam.
locales.name: Spam

locales.description: Account likely spamming shopping links.
locales.name: Shopping Spam

locales.description: Account is likely performing inauthentic fundraising.
locales.name: Inauthentic Fundraising

locales.description: Account has made 20+ replies with a link in a 24 hour period.
locales.name: 20+ Link Replies

locales.description: Account has made 10+ replies in the account's first hour of existence and their number of "top level" posts is considerably low. This is a common pattern with bots and accounts made for harassment purposes.
locales.name: 10+ Replies on New Account

locales.description: Account has made three or more starterpacks within a week.
locales.name: 3+ Starterpacks

locales.description: Account has been blocked 20+ times in a 24 hour period.
locales.name: 20+ Blocks

locales.description: Account has been blocked 100+ times in a 24 hour period.
locales.name: 100+ Blocks

locales.description: Account has changed their handle recently.
locales.name: Handle Changed

locales.description: Account has changed their handle 3+ times in a 24 hour period recently.
locales.name: 3+ Handle Changes

locales.description: This account changed their handle on an "aged" account. This might mean that a previously unused account has recently reactivated and started using a new handle, a common pattern with coordinated spam.
locales.name: Suspicious Handle Change

locales.description: This account is relatively new and in their initial posts has been found to be using one or more slurs which are generally found to be offensive. Accounts using slurs that take advantage of Unicode characters to "avoid" slur-use detection are also considered. False positives are possible, though should be extremely low.
locales.name: New Account Using Slurs

locales.description: Post label. This post has been found to be possibly toxic. Negative does not necessarily mean "bad", "rude", or "inappropriate", but rather that the sentiment of the post was found to be possibly negative. False positives may occur, and you should use caution if deciding to Hide based on this label.
locales.name: Negative Post

locales.description: This account has been verified to be part of a coordinated abuse network through one of various mechanisms. Only accounts that are verified to have an extremely high likelihood of being part of a coordinated spam, misinformation, or other network will have this label applied.
locales.name: Verified Coordinated Abuse

locales.description: This account has a handle that is likely to be an "Elon Spam" handle.
locales.name: Elon Handle

locales.description: This account is engaging in general inauthentic or spammy behavior. Usually linked to a ring of accounts performing a similar type of spam, for example Onlyfan spam bots.
locales.name: General Spam

locales.description: This post contains imagery that is likely NSFW in nature. False positives may occur, and caution is recommended if choosing to hide based on this label. Note that NSFW is not a judgement about a particular kind of content, but rather a distinction on whether something should appear on your screen at work or in public.
locales.name: Likely NSFW

locales.description: This post contains imagery that is possibly NSFW in nature. There is lower confidence in this content being NSFW than would warrant a "Likely NSFW" label. False positives may occur, and strong caution is recommended if choosing to hide based on this label. Note that NSFW is not a judgement about a particular kind of content, but rather a distinction on whether something should appear on your screen at work or in public.
locales.name: Possible NSFW
